model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of responses to the statement, “Design is well integrated into the product development process in our organization.” The chart contains five slices representing different levels of agreement. A blue slice labeled “Изцяло е интегриран.” accounts for 10 percent of the chart, followed by an orange slice labeled “Много добре е интегриран.” representing 24 percent. A green slice labeled “Добре е интегриран.” occupies 25 percent, while a red slice labeled “Слабо е интегриран.” represents 8 percent. Finally, a purple slice labeled “Не е интегриран такъв подход.” accounts for 20 percent of the chart. The chart includes a legend listing each label and its corresponding numerical value, and the slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
